apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stopping there — a dull headache plus light sensitivity after hitting your head is a possible concussion sign. That's outside what I program around. Don't climb or hangboard tonight; get it checked by a doctor before any return to training.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

No. Loss of consciousness isn't required for concussion — headache and light sensitivity after a head impact are themselves the red flags. I won't program bouldering or hangboard tonight. See a doctor before returning to training.
